coverage.notes: Preserved baseline geometry; local Dune and PHM art; ranked torrents expand, edition chooser, collection, staged download/ready/error states.
Read chooses exact staged edition. Explicit acquisition is acquire-only; ready actions permit Read/Listen.
Eight staged reading locations use two public-domain Austen excerpts; browser pagination is a UI fixture rather than EPUB engine output.
TOC/bookmarks/highlights/audio tabs; bookmark removal; highlight creation/edit/removal and notes.

Exact source anchored geometry via Reader2Logic.selectionMenuPos, transparent outside-click dismissal, 44px selection row with three source swatches, Note/Define/Copy and existing-highlight Delete, 300x128 expanding note editor, 320px Dictionary with loading/ok/empty states and staged Open in Wiktionary control, 360px serif Footnote with scrollable body. Search remains local to sample prose.

Six themes/custom colors, fonts/weight/size, spacing, indent/justify, page/scroll, constrained width, columns, hyphenation, ruler controls, default/reset confirmation. Native selects/ranges approximate source segments/sliders.
Custom CSS intentionally inert. Image inversion preference retained; sample prose has no embedded illustrations. Browser font weight synthesis and hyphenation differ from Qt/web engine.

Shared staged play/pause/seek/speed/volume/mute/sleep values, playlist, follow-reading and sync status/retry/restart confirmation; no actual audio/speech processing, timer engine or timestamps generated.
Audio route opens the current Reader2 Audio panel. AudiobookPlayer.qml absent at exact pin; no standalone native player asserted.

Top 10, extension preview, six house shelves and fixed full-width mosaics. Extension fixture supports ready/loading (six source-sized skeletons)/empty/error/disabled collapse; stable ext: key, reorder/hide/show and full extension Discover pin. Source-sized 130x182 covers and rank/source treatments. Catalogue limited to authentic Dune/PHM fixtures.

Both Chromium and Firefox assert source width/height and exact center/clamp/above-else-below positions. Screenshot review covers fresh/existing selection, note, dictionary loading/ok/empty/staged action and footnote.
Bounded local sample extension between Top 10 and house rails; skeleton and collapse cases, source metadata reveal, reorder and discover pin controls.

limitations: All acquisition, audio, read-along processing and account effects are local fixtures only.
Reader uses public-domain excerpts, not Dune or Project Hail Mary chapters. EPUB pagination/search locator accuracy and native mpv playback are not ported.
No current AudiobookPlayer.qml exists in source tree: reader.audio intentionally opens Reader2 Audio controls.
Custom CSS is inert; sleep timer setting is staged without a real audio clock.
Reader highlights are staged at paragraph granularity rather than exact native CFI text-range painting.
Extension-preview and dictionary responses use bounded local fixtures; external Wiktionary navigation is visibly staged and does not make a network call.
